new_result.statement: A rough-hub core whose valid frozen-slice Fourier estimate is |mu_l^(t)|<=A|t|^-1/2 has a whole-law L^3 density after the physical hub pairing. Convolution with one disjoint cap-one physical quadratic receiver aW^2+bW+c gives a continuous bounded density, uniformly in translations, fragmentation, unbounded supports and moments. Applying account04/B14 r9 eq. (3.6) yields ||p_Q||_inf <=45^(2/3)2^(8/9)|a|^(-1/3)|h|^(-4/9)|gamma|^(-2/9).

actual_premises: Original coordinates are independent and each marginal density is capped by one.
The r9 slice-Fresnel Fourier estimate (equation 3.6) remains valid; the prior correction refutes only the interval-only rough-hub endpoint.
A disjoint original-coordinate receiver W appears after conditioning as aW^2+b(z)W+c(z), with fixed a!=0 and no cross term to the retained unconditioned core.
Outside original coordinates may be arbitrary cap-one laws with unbounded fragmented supports and no moments.

partner_result_actually_applied.scope_used: Theorem 3.1 / equation (3.6) only: |mu_{l,g}^(t)|<=4 sqrt(pi)|gamma t|^-1/2, affine-uniform.
partner_result_actually_applied.scope_not_used: The interval-only rough-hub endpoint equation (4.1), challenged by the current correction.

unresolved_implication: The bare condition s_3(A)>=1 does not force a disjoint original-coordinate quadratic receiver. The overlapping third-resource/SP branch remains open.
